executiveSummary: One official procedural update meets publication criteria: the November 5 electricity session was postponed to the following week.

candidates.title: Cabinet postpones November 5 electricity session
candidates.summary: The Cabinet Secretariat announced on November 4 that the session scheduled for November 5 would move to the following week. Its signed agenda identifies electricity as the session’s subject. The postponement notice specifies neither a replacement date nor a reason.
candidates.whyItMatters: Analysis: the delay shifts the next opportunity for Cabinet consideration of the electricity file. Investors and operators should await a dated replacement agenda and published decisions before treating discussions as approvals.
candidates.publisher: Presidency of the Council of Ministers
candidates.relevanceToLebanon: This is a directly verified change to the Lebanese Cabinet’s timetable for considering the national electricity file.

verification.verificationNotes: Directly retrieved the controlling Secretariat notice and its earlier signed agenda. The agenda PDF has no embedded text; the full scanned page was rendered and visually read. Latest official listing reviewed for superseding notices. This is an official procedural scheduling decision, not enacted energy policy. MTV separately reports postponement but is not treated as independent proof of the motive. No legal status is changed.

verifiedFacts.claim: The Secretariat’s November 4 notice postpones the November 5 meeting to the following week.
The signed November 3 agenda identifies the planned November 5 meeting as a special electricity session.
